description: This file contains unit tests for the ExternalEventService class in the Fineract project. It verifies the behavior of posting different types of business events, including normal, bulk, transaction, and adjustment events, ensuring correct serialization, enrichment, and persistence.

classes.name: ExternalEventServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ExternalEventService, testing various scenarios of posting business events with serialization, enrichment, and persistence verification.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and the service instance before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets thread-local context after each test.

methods.name: testPostEventShouldFailWhenNullEventIsGiven
methods.description: Ensures postEvent throws IllegalArgumentException when given null.

methods.name: testPostEventShouldFailWhenEventSerializationFails
methods.description: Checks that a RuntimeException is thrown if serialization of the event fails.

methods.name: testPostEventShouldWorkWithRegularEvent
methods.description: Verifies that a standard business event is correctly serialized, enriched, and saved.

methods.name: testPostEventShouldWorkWithBulkEvent
methods.description: Verifies handling and persistence of bulk business events.

methods.name: testPostEventShouldSaveEventCategory
methods.description: Ensures the event category is correctly saved in the external event.

methods.name: testEventShouldSaveDatesInMilliSecondFormat
methods.description: Checks that event creation date is stored in millisecond accuracy.

methods.name: testPostEventShouldWorkWithTransactionEvent
methods.description: Verifies transaction events are processed as expected.

methods.name: testPostEventShouldWorkWithTransactionAdjustEvent
methods.description: Verifies adjustment transaction events are correctly processed.
